# XY chart syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-xychart/grammar/xychart.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

XY chart syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `xychart` and `xychart-beta`
diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed (an unclosed `%%{` takes the rest of the text, or ends
after a word argument); CRLF and CR read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read as `='x'`; `%%`
comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with `style…:…#…;` (or
`classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities read as opaque text (letters
outside ASCII); and a line break appended. Keywords are matched without regard to case.

Statements may end at a line break, `;` or the end of the text, but need not: `bar [1] line [2]`
is two plots. Text outside quotes is a run of letters, digits and `+ = * # _ . & -`, joined
without the blanks between them (`title Sales 2024` is `Sales2024`); quote it to keep blanks or
to use other characters. After `x-axis` and `y-axis` digits read as numbers (`x-axis Year2024
[a]` is a title and the start of a range), and inside a plot's brackets only numbers and quoted
labels are allowed. A `%%` right after a character other than `}` is a comment that takes that
character with it (`bar [1]%% c` loses its `]`).

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A chart is `xychart` (or `xychart-beta`), then statements. The header may come more than
once before the first statement; the last orientation given wins.

```ebnf
xychart = { eol | Header } document ;
```

```ebnf
Header @Header = XYCHART [ CHART_ORIENTATION ] ;
```

```ebnf
document = { statement { eol } } ;
```

```ebnf
eol = NEWLINE
    | SEMI
    | EOF ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Title
          | XAxis
          | YAxis
          | Plot
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr ;
```

`title <text>`: the chart title. The last one wins.

```ebnf
Title @Title = title text ;
```

`x-axis [<title>] [<a>, <b>, …]` (categories) or `x-axis [<title>] <min> --> <max>` (a
range), or just a title. Without data, the x axis is the range `1 --> n` of the first plot's n
values.

```ebnf
XAxis @Axis = X_AXIS ( text [ xAxisData ] | xAxisData ) ;
```

```ebnf
xAxisData = band
          | range ;
```

```ebnf
band = SQUARE_BRACES_START text { COMMA text } SQUARE_BRACES_END ;
```

```ebnf
range = NUMBER_WITH_DECIMAL ARROW_DELIMITER NUMBER_WITH_DECIMAL ;
```

`y-axis [<title>] <min> --> <max>`, or just a title. Without a range, the y axis spans the
plots' values.

```ebnf
YAxis @Axis = Y_AXIS ( text [ range ] | range ) ;
```

`bar [<name>] [<v>, <v>, …]` or `line [<name>] [<v>, …]`: a plot. A value may carry a point
label, `line [5 "peak", 6]` (drawn for lines only). A named plot gets a legend entry.

```ebnf
Plot @Plot = ( LINE | BAR ) [ text ] SQUARE_BRACES_START dataPoint { COMMA dataPoint } SQUARE_BRACES_END ;
```

```ebnf
dataPoint = NUMBER_WITH_DECIMAL [ STR ] ;
```

`accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the chart.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = acc_title acc_title_value ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description of the chart.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = acc_descr acc_descr_value
                   | acc_descr_multiline_value ;
```

Text: a run of words, digits and `+ = * # _ . & -`, joined without blanks, or a quoted
string.

```ebnf
text = alphaNumToken { alphaNumToken }
     | STR ;
```

```ebnf
alphaNumToken = AMP
              | NUM
              | ALPHA
              | PLUS
              | EQUALS
              | MULT
              | DOT
              | BRKT
              | MINUS
              | UNDERSCORE ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`, `string`, `axis_data`, `axis_band_data`, `data`, `data_inner`.

Every rule ignores case: a rule for `ab` also matches `AB` and `aB`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | — | `%%(?!\{)[^\n]*` |  | A `%%` comment after other text on a line, to the end of the line; the second form takes the character before it. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | — | `[^\}]%%[^\n]*` |  |  |
| axis_data | NEWLINE | `\r?\n` | pop | Line breaks, `;` and the end of the text end a statement. A line break ends an axis's data and a plot's. |
| data | NEWLINE | `\r?\n` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | NEWLINE | `[\n\r]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | — | `%%[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | title | `title\b` |  | `title <text>`: the chart title. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | acc_title | `accTitle\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | `accTitle: …` and `accDescr: …` take the rest of the line; `accDescr { … }` runs to `}`. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | acc_descr | `accDescr\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) |  |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | — | `accDescr\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^\}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | XYCHART | `xychart-beta\b` |  | `xychart` or `xychart-beta`: starts an XY chart, optionally followed by its orientation. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | XYCHART | `xychart\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | CHART_ORIENTATION | `(?:vertical\|horizontal)` |  | `vertical` (the default) or `horizontal`, right after `xychart`: which way the bars run. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | X_AXIS | `x-axis\b` | push(axis_data) | `x-axis` and `y-axis`: an axis's title and data. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | Y_AXIS | `y-axis\b` | push(axis_data) |  |
| axis_data | SQUARE_BRACES_START | `\[` | push(axis_band_data) |  |
| axis_data | ARROW_DELIMITER | `-->` |  | `-->`: between the two ends of an axis range. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | LINE | `line\b` | push(data) | `line` and `bar`: a plot, with an optional name and its values in brackets. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | BAR | `bar\b` | push(data) |  |
| data | SQUARE_BRACES_START | `\[` | push(data_inner) |  |
| axis_data, data_inner | NUMBER_WITH_DECIMAL | `[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?\|\.\d+)` |  | A number: an optional sign, then digits with an optional fraction, or `.` and digits. |
| data_inner, axis_band_data | SQUARE_BRACES_END | `\]` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | — | ``\)[ ]{36}\{ this\.pushState\(md_string\); \}\n<md_string>\(\?:\(\?!`"\)\.\)\…` | pop | The literal source text of v12's broken markdown-string rules, which jison compiled into one rule matching that text: a markdown string never opens. |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | — | `"` | push(string) | Strings: `"…"` (no escapes; it may span lines). |
| string | — | `"` | pop |  |
| string | STR | `[^"]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | SQUARE_BRACES_START | `\[` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | SQUARE_BRACES_END | `\]` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | ALPHA | `[A-Za-z]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | PLUS | `\+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | EQUALS | `=` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | MULT | `\*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | BRKT | `#` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | UNDERSCORE | `_` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | DOT | `\.` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | AMP | `&` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | MINUS | `-` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | NUM | `[0-9]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | SEMI | `;` |  |  |
| INITIAL, axis_data, axis_band_data, data, data_inner | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
